notes: Reconciliation: moved the appositional “even” from κατάρτισιν to ὑμῶν. The corpus never lets “even” reach across an intervening determiner to the noun; where a determiner stands between, it rides with the determiner-bearing token (JHN.14.17, JHN.14.26, JHN.11.27, JUD.1.4). Here rule 20 leaves the article unrepresented, so the possessive realizing ὑμῶν is that token.
